0022600210.text: The Pelicans (4-6, 11th in the West) have lost two straight and are 1-3 on the road as they visit the Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak and 5th in the West) in New Orleans' 11th game of the season. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision, while Yves Missi (knee bruise) is out for New Orleans after averaging 9.5 points and 19.6 minutes per game this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but the Pelicans won the most recent meeting 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
